style: Compact, counter-attacking side under Georgios Donis built around a strong Saudi Pro League core and continuity from the squad that beat Argentina in 2022. Looks to spring quick breaks through Al-Dawsari and Al-Buraikan; organized and disciplined defensively.
recent_form: Qualified through the AFC route, prioritizing continuity. Al-Buraikan finished as the side's top scorer in AFC qualifying with five goals.

key_players.name: Salem Al-Dawsari
key_players.note: 34-year-old captain (108 caps, 26 goals) at his third World Cup; scored the iconic winner against Argentina in 2022.

key_players.name: Firas Al-Buraikan
key_players.note: Al-Ahli forward and the squad's most dangerous finisher; top scorer in AFC qualifying with five goals, reliable left foot.

key_players.name: Saud Abdulhamid
key_players.note: France-based full-back bringing European experience to the back line.

key_players.name: Mohammed Al-Owais
key_players.note: Experienced first-choice keeper, part of the 2022 nucleus.

key_players.name: Salman Al-Faraj
key_players.note: Veteran midfield organizer providing continuity and control.

historical_news: Qualified for the 2026 World Cup via the AFC route under coach Georgios Donis.
Squad built around the continuity of the side that famously beat Argentina at Qatar 2022.
Al-Ahli supplied five players after their AFC Champions League triumph.
Captain Salem Al-Dawsari arrives at his third World Cup.
Squad selection prioritized Saudi Pro League experience over wider changes.

media_sentiment.label: neutral
media_sentiment.summary: Steady, expectation-managing coverage: belief in the experienced 2022 core and Al-Dawsari's leadership, but acknowledgment of limited squad turnover and a demanding draw featuring stronger European opposition.
